images.title: Cut, slide, and get a rectangle
images.purpose: Shows the parallelogram cutter's move in one frame: the right triangle cut off one end slides to the other end to make a 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle.
images.composition: One shape, large and centred: the rectangle formed, with the moved piece and its old place shown.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. A parallelogram with a horizontal base 7 units long and height 4 units, its top side shifted 2 units to the right of the base: corners at (0,0), (7,0), (9,4), (2,4). A grey (#6B7280) dashed vertical cut from (2,4) down to (2,0) with a small right angle mark at (2,0). The left right triangle with corners (0,0), (2,0), (2,4) is shown only as a grey dashed outline (its old place, no fill). The same triangle, filled amber (#E69F00), now sits at the right end with corners (7,0), (9,0), (9,4). The middle part with corners (2,0), (7,0), (9,4), (2,4) is filled teal (#0072B2). Together teal and amber form the rectangle (2,0), (9,0), (9,4), (2,4). One reddish purple (#CC79A7) curved arrow from the dashed outline over the top to the amber triangle. Labels: 7 cm under the rectangle's base; 4 cm beside the dashed cut; 28 cm² inside the teal part. Check: 7 × 4 = 28.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Cut and slide does not change the area: base × height = 7 × 4 = 28 cm².
images.description: Shows the parallelogram cutter's move in one frame: the right triangle cut off one end slides to the other end to make a 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle.
images.context: Practice concept with the parallelogram cutter tool (base 7, height 4).
images.teaching_notes: Ask whether the slanting side was needed anywhere.

image_decisions.why: Pictures the tool's one manipulation, cut and slide, in its simplest state.
